Good. I want the expectations round to be silent writing, not talking, because the loud people always dominate. Move it before the welcome and cut the welcome to five minutes. The welcome is always the part people forget, so keep it short and put the logistics on the printed card instead of saying them out loud.
Done: silent expectations first, welcome five minutes.
Don't add icebreakers, I never use them with this group. Instead give each table one printed question card.
